evidence_items.publisher: arXiv; Yucheng Li, Frank Guerin and Chenghua Lin
evidence_items.locator: Abstract; temporal comparison explained in section 5 and Figure 2 of the full paper
evidence_items.explanation: The paper compares benchmark overlap in Common Crawl from December 2020 through October 2023. This supports increasing contamination risk, but does not directly measure the proportion of successive model cohorts trained on those examples.

evidence_items.locator: Abstract; sections 3 and 4 of the full paper
evidence_items.explanation: The researchers find benchmark duplicates in Olmo3 training data and experimentally show that duplicate-based training can improve benchmark scores. A single model family and constructed training experiments do not establish an industry-wide increase over time.

unresolved_gaps: No comparable longitudinal measurement of the prevalence of benchmark-focused training across model cohorts was established.
Increasing internet contamination is not itself proof of increasing inclusion after developers filter training data.
The searches did not establish a corresponding measure of increasing financial stakes tied specifically to benchmark performance.
